headline: Waist-high SE leftovers this morning, clean but small — log it early.
today: Dawn's got a light WNW breeze going cross-off and it drops to a glassy 4mph W through mid-morning, so the window is right at first light through the morning tide before the SE cross-on fills in around midday. Only 1.2-1.4ft at 6s, so it's a log or nothing session — bring the biggest board you own. Skip the afternoon once that SE onshore turns it junky.

daysToWatch.note: Small at 0.7-1.1ft but that ESE line hits 9.9s at a prime angle and NNE cross-off holds all day. Clean and hollow-ish if it shows, worth a dawn look.

The day. ESE swell fills to 4.5ft at 12.5s on a prime angle and the wind goes light SE 3mph in the afternoon. Morning's a touch cross, afternoon glasses off — this is the one to build your weekend around, no drive needed.
Small SSE and W wind ramps to 18mph — cross and messy. Don't bother.
